label: Industrial yogurt, doogh and flavoured milk

branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: Product lines of Kalleh Dairy, an Iranian dairy company in Amol founded in 1991. They include yoghurt, strained yoghurt, doogh, and milk with various fat levels and flavours.

sources.text: Its product lines and brands, from the article.
